name: TableOfContents
purpose: Provide same-document navigation with one current location, scoped target tracking and interruptible navigation.
useWhen: A document needs a live outline of explicitly identified sections.

avoidWhen.condition: Items navigate routes or switch panels.

composition: Compose Root > Nav > Title and List > Item > Link. Place optional Indicator beside List, never directly inside ul. RootProvider accepts useTableOfContents for shared state.

rules.statement: Supply stable unique target IDs and heading depths. Keep labels, localization, extraction and page layout application-owned.
Keep links native; use one aria-current location, not tab or menu semantics. Native document mode uses browser hash navigation; managed mode scopes scrolling and has explicit history policy.
Name every Nav and identify its content scroll root separately from its optional rail viewport. Rail scrolling must not move ancestors.
Controlled activeId remains authoritative. visibleIds are visibility metadata, not multiple current locations. Use refresh after externally owned layout changes.

commonMistakes.mistake: Adding another observer in a styled wrapper or using page-specific offsets in the primitive.
commonMistakes.correction: Use the public controller and host-owned scroll margins/padding.

validation: Verify modifier clicks, immediate current feedback, interruption, long/final sections, scoped roots, focus, history, dynamic targets, SSR, refs and cleanup.
